ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: If plankticorous fish are removed from the food chain shown in the diagram, which organisms are likely to face starvation?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the image is a vertical food chain, with Phytoplankton (phytoplankton) at the bottom, Zooplankton (zooplankton) above it, Planktivorous fish (fish that eat plankton) above that, and Piscivorous fish (fish-eating fish) at the very top. An arrow points from the planktivorous fish to the piscivorous fish, indicating that the piscivorous fish feed on the planktivorous fish. Reasoning: The question asks which organisms might starve if the planktivorous fish are removed from the food chain. According to food chain rules, predators that lose their main food source are most likely to face starvation. Therefore, the piscivorous fish might starve because they lose the planktivorous fish as a food source.
